    Rubbing castor oil in was never enough. A few drops on the skin cannot reach the detox and lymphatic pathways underneath. The Healo pack holds a full dose of practitioner-grade, hexane-free oil sealed against your skin for hours, so the oil goes into you, not into your sheets.

    Frequently asked questions

    How many nights a week do I wear it?

    Most women start with 3 to 5 nights a week. Pour, strap, sleep, and let consistency do the heavy lifting. The Ritual Guide included free with your kit gives you the exact protocol.

    Will it stain my sheets or pajamas?

    No. The pack is triple-layered with a leak-proof backing and a sealed border, so the oil stays against your skin instead of escaping into fabric.

    Where exactly do I place it?

    Over your liver, on the right side just under your ribs. That placement supports your body's main filter during its overnight repair hours. The guide also covers thyroid, belly and joint placements.

    Do I need a heating pad?

    No. Your own body heat, trapped by the pack's layers, is what activates the oil overnight. There is a built-in pocket if you ever want to add one for extra warmth.

    How long does one bottle last?

    The 16 fl oz bottle is our largest size and typically lasts about 2 months of consistent nightly use.

    Can I return my order?

    Yes. Every order is covered by the 60-night money-back guarantee. If you do not feel the difference, you get your money back.
